question: With which OTT provider has the Ministry of Tourism signed a non-commercial MoU to promote India’s tourism destinations globally?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Netflix.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The Ministry of Tourism has signed a non-commercial MoU with Netflix Entertainment Services India to globally promote India’s tourism destinations through cinematic storytelling.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The MoU aims to showcase India’s natural landscapes, cultural heritage, and iconic sites.**
 
• **Promotion includes destinations across India, including the state of Gujarat.**
 
• **The partnership leverages Netflix’s global reach to highlight India’s tourism potential.**
 
• **The collaboration focuses on visual storytelling and cinematic representation, not commercial transactions.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Netflix**__

 __
 
• A global OTT platform offering films, documentaries and series in multiple languages.
 
• Widely used for tourism promotion due to its strong global audience base.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Tourism (India)**__
 __
 
• Responsible for formulating national policies for tourism development.
 
• Promotes India as a global tourist destination through campaigns and partnerships.
 
 
 
• **MoU (Memorandum of Understanding)**__
 __
 
• A formal agreement outlining cooperation between two parties.
 
• Non-commercial MoUs do not involve financial obligations.
 
 
 
• **Cinematic Storytelling**__
 
 
• Use of visual media to depict destinations, culture and heritage.
 
• Has proven impact on influencing global travel choices.
